reference_task.success_reward_scaling: native DQ per-success reward, not multiplied by dt
reference_task.candidate_forward: native height >= threshold AND EE distance < .2 AND opening < .5
reference_task.candidate_backward: sigmoid margins; explicit surrogate, not physical contact derivative
reference_task.success_backward: counted ST gate with gradient-only scale
reference_task.imagined_terminal_continuation: source candidate*(count+1) without native completed latch; hypothetical tail rewards retained for ST derivatives, excluded by survival forward
reference_task.holding: relative object/tool linear and angular slip; no world-velocity penalty
reference_task.cost_actions: issued continuous high-level actions; gripper excluded from magnitude only
reference_task.native_task: real rewards, reset statistics and success labels unchanged

loss_contract.main: trainer state_loss_reduction selects mean (legacy equal-group weights) or sum (62 unweighted standardized physical residuals)
loss_contract.relative_auxiliary: mean of five normalized group mean-square errors in the EE frame
loss_contract.relative_orientation: sign-invariant quaternion chord, scaled by 2 (local radians)
loss_contract.physical_sum: 62 standardized physical residuals, unweighted squared sum
loss_contract.main_rotation: shortest quaternion logarithm (rotation vector in radians)
loss_contract.contact: four sensor labels, BCE; hard binary low-policy inputs

metadata.critic_ee_geometry: reconstructed by FK in policy observation; stale serialized cache excluded
